While headline indices churn, genuine Stage 2 leaders with accelerating quarterly earnings and sales are decoupling from the crowd. Per CANSLIM principles, exposure must be concentrated exclusively in high relative strength names breaking out of sound bases on expanding volume, while fundamentally lagging candidates are relegated to watchlists. analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

63MOONS.technical: Rounded cup with a 10.5% handle forming a double bottom neckline above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. RSI at 63 demonstrates positive momentum, though it has not yet confirmed a volume-backed pivot breakout.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite 131.7% standalone top-line growth, consolidated operations generated a net loss of Rs 40.43 crore in Q2 FY27. Return ratios remain deeply sub-par with ROE of -2.0% and ROCE of -3.7%, failing O'Neil's CANSLIM criteria despite an almost debt-free balance sheet.
63MOONS.risk: Failure below 886.75 breaches the handle low and 50-day SMA; Minervini discipline mandates immediate risk cut to prevent capital erosion.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price holds above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, pressing within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on 1.66x volume with RSI 61. Base structure shows constructive contraction but lacks institutional accumulation footprint.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Performance is heavily impaired with Q1 FY27 net profit contracting 25.6% YoY to Rs 1.02 crore on a 56.3% plunge in sales. With a low 3-year average ROE of 3.1% and promoter dilution, fundamentals fail CANSLIM quality filters.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A breakdown below 104.57 violates the 50-day SMA and invalidates the pivot attempt, triggering an instant stop-loss exit.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Setting up a constructive double-bottom neckline retest within 1.5% of the 513.51 pivot. Price trades well above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, backed by bullish MACD above signal and zero.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Q2 FY27 PAT surged 83.2% YoY to Rs 82.8 crore on 26.6% revenue growth, propelled by formulation mix and EBITDA margin expansion to 16.6%. ROCE of 12.0% and modest leverage support strong CANSLIM institutional momentum.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Decisive close below 455.37 violates the swing low and 50-day moving average, requiring immediate defensive liquidation.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Clear Stage 2 advancing leadership displaying a textbook SEPA pivot breakout to fresh 52-week highs on 2.96x volume. Price is powerfully stacked above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with high relative strength.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Q2 FY27 delivered explosive fundamental expansion with PAT surging 155.8% YoY to Rs 71.5 crore on 46% top-line growth. Operating leverage expanded EBITDA margins to 22.2%, anchored by high-margin CDMO and xanthine volume expansion.
AARTIPHARM.risk: A break below 907.75 invalidates the high-volume breakout bar and 21-day EMA, triggering strict Minervini stop discipline.

AARVI.technical: Consolidating constructively above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, within 1.5% of the 161.16 pivot. MACD resides above signal and zero line, but breakout volume confirmation remains absent.
AARVI.fundamental: Solid profitability with Q1 FY27 PAT growing 41.9% YoY to Rs 5.99 crore, supported by a healthy order book. However, top-line growth of 14.1% falls short of CANSLIM's 15% threshold, and EPS growth is decelerating from prior quarters.
AARVI.risk: A fall below 146.04 breaches key moving averages and prior base lows, terminating the setup under risk protocols.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Powerhouse SEPA breakout clearing multi-week resistance to fresh 52-week highs on 2.87x volume. Price trends above rising 21, 50, and 200-day moving averages with MACD positive and accelerating relative strength.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Robust financial powerhouse performance with Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT surging 38% YoY to Rs 1,288 crore and revenue up 31% YoY. Lending AUM jumped 32% with improving asset quality, confirming genuine institutional sponsorship.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Reversal below 390.48 breaches breakout support and the 21 EMA, requiring immediate stop execution to cap loss under 6.5%.
